newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wilson & Horton directors urge don't sell.
newsitem.headline: Wilson & Horton directors urge don't sell.

text.p: The independent directors of Wilson and Horton Ltd on Monday urged shareholders not to sell their stake in the company.
They are negotiating with Independent Press Communications with regard to the cash price of the takeover offer and said further information would follow as soon as possible.
Independent Newspapers Plc is bidding through its wholly-owned subsidiary Independent Press Communications for the entire issued share capital of Wilson and Horton at NZ$10.50/share.
It already holds a 22.6 percent interest, with the same amount in the hands of family trusts linked to Independent chairman Tony O'Reilly.
On Friday, shares in Wilson and Horton shed 13 cents to $10.57 after Southpac Corp Ltd, acting as an independent appraiser, said INP's offer was fair.
The shares continued trading at that level shortly after the "don't sell" announcement.
